posts.creator: loko.korea
posts.title: Han River Drone Light Show — Marvel special
posts.notes: **Sat 31 Oct**, ~20:30, free, cultural performances + food market on site. Creator's own comment lists the autumn dates: 12 Sep, 9 Oct, **31 Oct (Marvel)**. Expect it to be rammed — transport out is the pinch point. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DcFMLcSp0Qm)
posts.fit: 🟡 **Halloween night, Seoul, free, Marvel** — worth breaking the "low-key evening" rule for. Verify on the Seoul city site nearer the time.

posts.creator: chestertravelchingu
posts.title: Eunpyeong Hanok Village
posts.location: Base of Bukhansan; 10-min bus from Yeonsinnae Stn (Line 3)
posts.notes: Saved **twice** — both posts say the same thing: skip Bukchon, it's packed, steep and the residents are fed up. Eunpyeong is quieter, spacious, modern hanoks against the mountain. Café **Irin Iljan (1in 1jan)** has the money view. [post 1](https://instagram.com/p/DcEpmipz6l_) · [post 2](https://instagram.com/p/Dab2lQyz7nO)
posts.fit: 🟡 Direct challenge to **Sat 24 PM (Bukchon)**. Trade-off: Eunpyeong is ~40 min out vs Bukchon being 5 min from the Moxy.

posts.title: Seoul City Hall (new building) + Haneul Observation Deck
posts.notes: Free. The basement/atrium is the photogenic bit; creator regrets missing the sky deck. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DbJ3QK4tccU)
posts.fit: 🟡 Free, 10 min from **ENA Suite (Namdaemun)** — a Sun 25 Oct post-DMZ filler or a Mon 26 morning warm-up.

posts.creator: fulltimetrippin
posts.title: KBO baseball at Jamsil Stadium
posts.notes: Cheap tickets, BYO snacks and drinks, a chant per player, cheerleaders — described as a 3-hour party rather than a sport. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DZ6DzFAyzhx)
posts.fit: 🔴 Regular season ends early Oct; only **postseason** games would be live in our window, at playoff prices/availability. Check the KBO postseason schedule in Oct.

posts.creator: hayleybunz
posts.title: Lotte Cinema World Tower
posts.notes: The "watch a film in a ridiculous cinema" experience; creator's only regret was picking a short film. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DZM8seoOZAv)
posts.fit: ⚪ Only lands if Mon 26 = **Lotte World (Option B)** and there's a wet-weather hour to kill.

posts.creator: the.a.cho
posts.title: Seoul City Tour Bus (night tour)
posts.notes: Open-top night route; summer departure 19:30, arrive 30 min early for a good seat. No pets. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DaUPUR6vOQV)
posts.fit: ⚪ Late-Oct departure will be earlier than 19:30 — check. A lazy option for a tired evening.

posts.creator: yesjmo
posts.title: Namsan: walk up for sunset, cable car down
posts.notes: Contrarian to our plan. ~1 hour on foot from Haebangchon, enter near Namsan Gate Ball Field. Bring your own padlock (₩15,000 in the gift shop). [post](https://instagram.com/p/DafUH1LNMEj)
posts.fit: 🟢 We do Namsan **Fri 23 eve** — but jet-lagged, with an 8-year-old, cable car **up** stays right. Take the padlock tip.

posts.creator: kbeauty.real.gems
posts.title: Optima Wellness Museum
posts.notes: A pharmacy rebuilt as a gallery — 3,000+ curated products displayed like exhibits, a scanning station that reads stress index, blood pressure, grip strength, body composition and skin, then a pharmacist portions supplements into daily packets. Legal only since a 2020 exemption; a pharmacist has to be present. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DbibCnHGJyL)
posts.fit: ⚪ A genuinely odd hour in Gangnam, and a different kind of souvenir. Not near any of our three bases.

posts.creator: seoulcity
posts.title: Seoul International Garden Show + The Seoul My Soul Lounge
posts.location: Seoul Forest, Seongdong-gu (Ttukseom / Seoul Forest Stn)
posts.notes: A signed garden route through Seoul Forest — K-Heritage Garden (traditional walls, numaru pavilion, terraced beds), *Sitting in Seoul* (wildfire-damaged trees remade as benches), Green Pulse (climate/carbon garden) — ending at the **Seoul My Soul Lounge** on the Central Lawn: Seoul goods, food zone, brand shops. Lounge runs **31 Jul – 27 Oct 2026, 10:30–21:00**, free. Posted by @seoulcity, the official city account. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DcNtjtPAhBM)
posts.fit: 🟡 **Time-limited and it lands inside our window** — closes Mon 27 Oct, the morning we take the KTX. Realistically **Fri 23 PM** (instead of/alongside Cheonggyecheon, both Jongno-adjacent) or a **Mon 26 morning** if Everland's shuttle is the 09:30 one. Big open park, free, low-commitment — good jet-lag terrain.

posts.creator: deargitta
posts.title: Haus Nowhere — Gentle Monster HQ
posts.notes: Gentle Monster's flagship concept building: a whole day's worth of installation-scale retail theatre rather than a shop. Free to walk. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DcJcZt2yezO)
posts.fit: ⚪ Seongsu isn't on any of our days as it stands. Would only work bundled with Seoul Forest (10 min apart) — which is the one thing that could make a Seongsu half-day worth it.

posts.creator: myfirstkorea
posts.title: TOVA Bath House — private 1-person sauna
posts.notes: Newly opened single-occupancy sauna: your own room, two-tier bench (sit low for gentle heat, lie high for the real thing), magnesium/Epsom mineral-salt bath. Booking link released by commenting on the post. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DcLPbbVkQI-)
posts.fit: 🔴 One person per room by design — the opposite of a family trip. Club D Oasis in Busan already covers the spa itch for all three of you.

posts.creator: carbsmakeitokay
posts.title: Haebangchon (HBC) neighbourhood
posts.location: Yongsan-gu, just south of Namsan Tower
posts.notes: Laid-back cafés, wine bars and vintage boutiques — the walking-around bit of the Namsan evening rather than a destination. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DZ9MYD5qL7e)
posts.fit: ⚪ Second save pointing at HBC (the Namsan sunset route also runs through it). Adults-in-daylight territory; no obvious 8-year-old hook.

posts.creator: genesia.synclaire
posts.title: Discover Seoul Pass (72h)
posts.notes: Creator's maths: Lotte World + N Seoul Tower + Nami + palaces/hanbok + Seoul Aquarium + Realworld Seongsu = ₩208,000 of entry for a ₩90,000 72h pass, transport card and eSIM included. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DZFLzrlqTfu)
posts.fit: 🟡 **Worth modelling against our actual list.** Our Seoul entries are thinner (Everland/Lotte are outside or partly outside the pass) — do the sums before buying three.

posts.creator: yourmajestjae
posts.title: Skyline Luge Busan
posts.notes: Gravity karts down a hillside track, plus a zipline. **She can ride solo** — the rule is 110cm and age 6+, and she's 132cm and 8. An adult must be 150cm+ to double up, so that option exists too. Typically 10:00–18:00; the site flags closures, so check the day before. ~30–40 min north-east of Haeundae. Surfaced by two separate saves. [post 1](https://instagram.com/p/DcKCT_Khi28) · [post 2](https://instagram.com/p/Db8f-SNNc4o)
posts.fit: 🟡 **Now competing with Club D Oasis for Fri 30 Oct.** Luge is the bigger thrill; the water park is the easier day.

posts.creator: busansaeki
posts.title: Club D Oasis
posts.notes: Spa + **water park**. From the creator's own comments: all-use ticket **₩38,000 for 10 hours** (most spas cap at 4), swim cap and life vest mandatory in the water park (vest rentable ₩8,000). Explicitly "not crazy slides — perfect for families". [post](https://instagram.com/p/DaAEyCMp8f3)
posts.fit: 🟡 **Best new find for Busan.** Fri 30 Oct is our deliberately-empty day and she loves swimming. 10 min from the Grand Josun.

posts.creator: tanvi_in_transit_
posts.title: Busan Sky Capsule + Blueline Park
posts.notes: Saved **twice**. Combined tips: book on the official Haeundae Blue Line Park site, reservations open **4 weeks ahead**, sunset slots go first, ride **Mipo → Cheongsapo** for the coastline on your side, ~30 min one way, price is **per capsule** (2p ₩50,000 / 3p ₩55,000 / 4p ₩60,000), arrive 20–30 min early. Second post pushes a ~$65 day tour that bundles the capsule if tickets sell out. [post 1](https://instagram.com/p/Dbdc30SIM4c) · [post 2](https://instagram.com/p/DZvytiSPny2)
posts.fit: 🟢 Booked plan is Tue 27 ~16:30 Mipo→Cheongsapo — **the direction matches**. The 4-week window backs up our "tickets release ~13 Oct" note. Keep the day-tour fallback in the back pocket.

posts.creator: moosimi_busan
posts.title: Jwacheon Station residents' monorail, after dark
posts.notes: A **free** local monorail up the hillside; raw night view of the city with no observatory crowd. Residential — be quiet and respectful. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DY-LnA2z22E)
posts.fit: ⚪ Lovely, but it's a late-evening trek across town with a child. Adults-only fantasy.

posts.creator: korean.studynotes
posts.title: Shinsegae Centum City
posts.notes: Billed as the world's largest department store — luxury, outlet floors and an **indoor ice rink**; connected to Centum City Mall. Tip: look up which building your brand is in first, it's a long walk. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DcD5BEzztgQ)
posts.fit: ⚪ Genuine wet-weather Plan B for Busan; the ice rink is the hook for her.

posts.creator: aidenandmaddy
posts.title: Jeonju Hanok Village
posts.notes: 800+ hanoks. Eat: PNB Bakery choco pies, Gyodong 10-won cheese bread, Hankook Jib (Jeonju bibimbap), Cafe Flatmate, SOBOK matcha. See: Gyeonggijeon Shrine (hanbok), Jeondong Cathedral, Jaman Mural Village, Omokdae & Hanbyeokdang pavilions, Green Circle viewpoint. Creator says stay a night, don't day-trip. [post](https://instagram.com/p/Db7oZY0h7YM)
posts.fit: 🔴 No room in 4-4-2. File for a future trip.

posts.creator: theluxurylowdown
posts.title: Suwon day tour
posts.notes: Waujeongsa Temple · Hwaseong Palace (martial arts demo) · Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO) · **Starfield Library Suwon** · Seaweed Museum (kimbap-making + hanbok). ~$55 USD guided. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DX-tLgBKdaV)
posts.fit: 🔴 Our Seoul days are full; the kimbap-making beat is already covered by Museum Kimchikan on Sun 1 Nov.

posts.creator: mimiyako_
posts.title: Hannam-dong Hanbang Chicken
posts.notes: Herbal whole fried chicken; the crispy skin is the whole point. **Second save adds the detail:** wood-fired, and it's a *young* chicken (the same bird used for samgyetang) so the meat falls off the bone. Eat it with the sticky rice and kimchi — several commenters say the rice is the best part. Moved to the current premises ~2 years ago and expanded upstairs. Arrive by **17:00** or expect 1–1.5h; the queue forms fast. Dissenting commenters call the meat bland without the sauces.

posts.title: VAT / tax refund at ICN
posts.group: Airport & flying home — read before 2 Nov
posts.notes: **VAT / tax refund at ICN.** Carry your passport when shopping, spend ≥₩15,000 at tax-free-certified shops, ask for the VAT receipt at the till. At ICN, scan receipts at the kiosks on the **departures level before checking bags**, then collect cash airside. Keep luxury buys unboxed for customs. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DbnPdOqiio6) — 🟡 Free money on the K-beauty haul; adds ~15 min to the airport plan.

posts.creator: experiencekorea_naver
posts.title: Climate Card change — tourists are NOT affected
posts.notes: **Climate Card change — tourists are NOT affected.** The 30-day Climate Card ends in August 2026 and is being replaced for residents; the **short-term tourist Climate Cards (1/2/3/5/7-day, unlimited Seoul subway + bus) continue unchanged**. K-Pass and Modu Card are the resident alternatives and are irrelevant to us. Posted by @experiencekorea_naver, sourcing Seoul Metropolitan Government. [post](https://instagram.com/p/DbaUZu3E8dJ) — 🟡 **Worth a sum.** We have 4 Seoul days at the front (23–27 Oct) and 2 at the back. A **5-day card** for the first leg vs topping up T-money: the card pays off at roughly 4–5 journeys a day, which we'll hit on the palace and theme-park days but not on the DMZ day. ⚠️ Note the daughter's fare — check whether the tourist Climate Card is sold as a child version before buying three; if not, hers stays on the registered T-money.

posts.notes: **Everyday items that are illegal across a border.** Not Korea-specific, but the principle holds: cold medicine above certain pseudoephedrine thresholds, pepper spray, vapes and fresh food all change legal status at customs.
